glowthread-desc: Comments under wiki articles, with likes, reports, moderation and Special:Log coverage
glowthread-special-nojs: The comment moderation tools need JavaScript. Every moderation action is listed in [[Special:Log/glowthread|the comment log]].
glowthread-link-notfound: This comment does not exist or is not visible to you.
glowthread-nojs: Comments need JavaScript. Turn on JavaScript in your browser to read and write comments.
glowthread-filter:
# Word filter for comments. A comment that matches a rule is held for review, never rejected.
# One rule per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A plain line matches whole words, ignoring case and accents: "spam" matches "Spam!", "spàm" and "s p a m" but not "spammer". A line written with accents matches only the same accents.
# Its words match with or without spaces or punctuation between them: "cheap coins" also matches "cheap-coins" and "cheapcoins".
# A plain line with Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Lao, Khmer or Myanmar letters matches anywhere, even with spaces, symbols or ASCII punctuation between its characters, but not across a line break, full-width punctuation such as 。 and ，, or brackets and quotes such as 「」.
# A line like /pattern/flags is a regular expression (flags: i, m, s, x).
# At most 2000 rules are used, and the lines after them are ignored.
log-description-glowthread: Moderation of comments: deletions, restorations, approvals, pins, report reviews, erasures, per-page comment settings and settings changes.
log-description-glowthread-private: Who wrote comments that were erased. Visible only to users who can erase comments.
log-description-comments: Comment moderation recorded by FlowThread, the comment system this wiki used before. Newer entries are in the comment log.
logentry-comments-erase: $1 {{GENDER:$2|erased}} a comment by $4 on $3, along with $5 {{PLURAL:$5|reply|replies}}
logentry-comments-markchecked: $1 {{GENDER:$2|marked}} a comment by $4 on $3 as checked
glowthread-logentry-markchecked: $1 {{GENDER:$2|dismissed}} the reports on comment $4 by $5 on $3
glowthread-logentry-autohold: $1 {{GENDER:$2|held}} comment $4 by $5 on $3 for review after several reports
glowthread-logentry-undo: $1 {{GENDER:$2|undid}} the action of log entry $7 on comment $4 by $5 on $3
glowthread-log-undelete-state: Kept the stricter comment setting of the earlier page whose revisions were restored here
right-glowthread-trusted: Post comments without the new-account review

glowthread-error-disabled: Comments are turned off on this page.
glowthread-error-locked: Comments on this page are locked. No new comments or replies can be added.
glowthread-error-too-long: The comment is too long. The limit is $1 {{PLURAL:$1|character|characters}}.
glowthread-error-too-many-mentions: A comment can mention at most $1 {{PLURAL:$1|user|users}}.
glowthread-error-duplicate: You already posted this comment here a moment ago.
glowthread-error-too-many-held: You have $1 {{PLURAL:$1|comment|comments}} waiting for review. Please wait until a moderator has reviewed {{PLURAL:$1|it|them}} before posting more.
glowthread-error-undo-logids: To undo, give one log ID (logids) for each comment ID (ids), in the same order.
glowthread-error-parent: The comment you are replying to is not available.
glowthread-error-comment-missing: This comment does not exist or is not visible.
glowthread-error-own-like: You cannot like your own comment.

glowthread-error-own-report: You cannot report your own comment.
glowthread-error-report-reason: This report reason is not available.
glowthread-error-note-too-long: The note is too long. The limit is $1 {{PLURAL:$1|character|characters}}.
glowthread-error-not-author: Only the author can delete this comment this way.
glowthread-error-bad-status: The action "$1" does not apply to a comment with status "$2".
glowthread-error-setting-range: The setting "$1" must be between $2 and $3.
glowthread-error-setting-range-off: The setting "$1" must be $4 (off) or between $2 and $3.
glowthread-error-setting-invalid: The value for "$1" is not valid.
glowthread-error-setting-locked: The setting "$1" is fixed in the wiki configuration and cannot be changed here.
glowthread-error-settings-json: The settings must be a JSON object of setting names and values.
glowthread-rest-page-not-found: The page does not exist or you cannot read it.
glowthread-rest-comment-not-found: The comment does not exist or is not visible to you.
glowthread-rest-bad-cursor: The paging cursor is not valid.
glowthread-rest-permission-denied: You do not have permission to see this.
